title: Concept2 Interval Pace Fade
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=concept2:workout piece_type=interval
| stats first(avg_split_sec) as opening_split, last(avg_split_sec) as closing_split by workout_id athlete
| eval fade_sec=closing_split-opening_split
| where fade_sec>5
| sort - fade_sec
description: Uses Concept2 Logbook workouts telemetry to monitor pace fade from the first interval to the final interval in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for rowing sessions where endurance disappeared late, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Concept2 Logbook workouts data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Scatter plot of interval workouts ranked by pace fade.
grandmaExplanation: It totals pace fade from the first interval to the final interval so you can spot rowing sessions where endurance disappeared late before it becomes annoying.
